caseName: Yates v. W. Contra Costa Unified Sch. Dist.
caseNameFull: Fernando YATES v. WEST CONTRA COSTA UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until October 22, 2018, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
